whatsapp.beforeTitle: Before you start, have at hand:
whatsapp.before2: An app on Meta for Developers with the WhatsApp product added.
whatsapp.before3: The number you will use — Meta's test number is fine to try things out.
whatsapp.phoneNumberIdHint: In the app: WhatsApp → API Setup, right under the number. Digits only.
whatsapp.wabaIdHint: On the same page, under “WhatsApp Business Account ID”.
whatsapp.tokenHint: The temporary token on the API page expires in 24 hours. For real use, create a permanent system-user token with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management:
whatsapp.pinHint: 6 digits. Only for your own (production) number; test numbers don't need it.
whatsapp.missingFields: Fill in the phone number ID, the WhatsApp Business Account ID and the token.
whatsapp.connectFailed: Could not connect. Check the details and try again.
whatsapp.alreadyConnected: This number is already connected. To change or tune it, use the advanced settings.
whatsapp.registrationSkipped: Number saved without registration (no PIN). For production numbers, enter the PIN in the advanced settings to receive messages.
whatsapp.webhookTitle: Last step: tell Meta where to deliver messages
whatsapp.webhookStep1: In your Meta app, open WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhook → Edit.
whatsapp.webhookStep2: Paste the callback URL and verify token below and click Verify and save.
whatsapp.verifyTokenHint: Copy it now: it is stored encrypted and not shown again. If you lose it, generate a new one in the advanced settings.
whatsapp.advancedHint: Prefer the full screen, with diagnostics and number registration?
whatsapp.businessIdHint: In Business Settings → Business info. Helps support find your account.

actions.suspendBody: Blocks sending messages, campaigns, automations and new integrations. Users still sign in, view and export their data; inbound messages keep reaching the inbox. Nothing is deleted. A payment does not lift a suspension made by the team.
actions.reactivateBody: The organization returns to its status before the suspension and sending is unlocked.
actions.planBody: Until billing exists, the plan is set by hand. The change is recorded in the audit log.
actions.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. 60 days overdue, customer request, abuse…
